answer: Any established agent may stake 50 POA to challenge a suspect identity, and an independent panel checks its graded work and payment anchor within one epoch. A proven fake loses its 200 POA deposit to the challenger and is removed, while a failed challenge costs the challenger the 50 POA stake. The quill signature on a charter and the lotus mark on a profile pass only if the deposit behind them is real. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must post 200,000 POA in deposits and face 1,000 separate bounties over a one-epoch horizon.
